title: Syntyr CMS Starter
description: A portable, accessible Syntyr landing page edited with Git-backed CMS tools.

sections.heading: Edit content. Keep your HTML.
sections.description: Your design belongs to Syntyr, your content lives in JSON, and your editor can change without changing your website.

items.title: Framework independent
items.description: The same page works with native HTML, Go, Python or a JavaScript application.

items.title: No client renderer
items.description: Prebuilt HTML and CSS ship without an application JavaScript bundle.

items.title: Git-backed changes
items.description: CMS editors update source files instead of holding content in a proprietary database.

items.question: Do I need a CMS at runtime?
items.answer: No. Sveltia and Pages CMS are editors; the published page is HTML and CSS.

items.question: Can I switch between editors?
items.answer: Yes. Both examples edit the same JSON document; rebuilding uses the same renderer.

sections.heading: Start with the free core
sections.description: Copy this starter into your own Git repository and connect the editor you prefer.
